definition.label: A physical pour was saved
definition.description: A native pouring episode was accepted by the shared room journal (or temporary fork). Value/source is the outgoing vessel ID. transferredMl is the total received by containers; spilledMl left the bounded container model, and does not imply a persistent puddle. receivers counts distinct receiving containers. Emitted after successful publication only; failed saves, cancellation, Undo and reload do not emit/replay it. A long continuous flow publishes at most once per ten-second checkpoint. Paused lifecycle listeners may miss the event; inspect current contents instead.

definition.label: Live liquid scooping
definition.description: Current physical-flow episode: scoopedMl entered this vessel through its submerged opening; drawnMl was taken from it by other vessels. donors/recipients count distinct counterpart vessels. These counters reset on publication or rollback. Read object.container.live for current and accepted quantities. An upward-facing smaller open cavity must fit inside the donor with its entire opening below the measured surface, with a clear bounded path. The same conserved quantities, physics pause, grips, save/Undo and temporary-room episode are used for pouring and scooping. No fluid forces, displacement, air simulation or persistent pools.
